study.question: Does a compact continuous-freshness residual transplanted from g0-r0016-oldest_bound improve exchangeable_joint beyond both frozen source bests and equally allocated readouts of already available evidence?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: source audit shows exchangeable_joint encodes action/coarse-age histograms and learned log2-age buckets, but no continuous age statistic beyond timestamp-equality/order support; age perturbations within the same log2 and coarse bins that preserve ties leave its representation unchanged. Source oldest_bound has count, one-day decay mean, second moment, and a moment-derived lower bound in each of 16 exclusive match/action cells, gated by four learned match pools and count statistics. Continuous within-bin freshness could complement the stronger exchangeable representation. Shared grouped-history ancestry makes most counts and coarse freshness redundant. This is an incremental-access hypothesis, not an assertion that order or all source mechanisms are complementary.

nearest_work.difference: Retain its exact parameters, allocation order and representation; append the compact source residual rather than change its exchangeable expected-edge or identity/group summaries. Measured seed42 AUC .6218776973444221, Logloss .19386964655025898, 17187571 parameters, 770.0541433 wall seconds, 24.5769094 inference seconds.

Transplant its exclusive count/decay-mean/decay-second-moment/lower-bound encoding and 32-unit RMS-normalized multiplicative gate, sharing exchangeable parent pools and embeddings; do not ensemble its separate static MLP. Omit unused actual extrema/cumulative computations, retain selected formula. Source seed42 AUC .6205915285296155, Logloss .19567601788078123, 17141187 parameters, 633.3794422 wall seconds, 18.9894824 inference seconds. Bound is a derived moment feature, not an observed oldest-event statistic.

DIN uses ad-conditioned activation and unnormalized weighted sums retaining interest intensity. This proposal inherits fixed category/brand match groups and count/freshness summaries, not DIN local activation or a novel general attention/gating primitive. baseline-din uses normalized softmax attention and is an adaptation, not an exact paper reproduction. No priority claim.

README confirms category/brand/action histories without item identifiers; bucket-pair identity is not item identity. Publisher full text unavailable through supplied source; no DMR-mechanism reproduction or novelty relative to full DMR is established.

inherited_components: Frozen host data, causal prefix, supplied history length128, all exposures, natural prevalence, 3 epochs, batch4096, seed42, lr.001 and default optimizer/loss. No new inputs, labels or auxiliary objectives.

Entire exchangeable_joint source with exact constructor prefix and inherited methods; shared static/category/brand/action/log2-age embeddings, match pools, count statistics, histograms, independent moments, global field readout, identity/context/repeat/overlap and exchangeable-edge residuals.

Compact source 16 exclusive match/action counts, mean exp(-age/86400), second decay moment and lower=clamp(mean-sqrt((n-1)*max(second-mean^2,0)),0,1), zero for empty cells; 32-unit residual gated by inherited68-dimensional pooled context.

Compact source module order: 32->32->1 bias-free ReLU correction with zero last weight; 68->32 context; 16->32 zero moment projection; 16->32 zero bound projection. All appended after the exchangeable parent.
study.proposed_difference: A single shared-backbone gated residual with64 inputs [16 log1p counts/log129,16 mean decay,16 second moments,16 derived lower bounds]. Four equally allocated modes: continuous raw-age moments; coarsened moments computed only from existing 4-bin action/match histogram using decay at bin lower edges0,3600,86400,604800 seconds; duplicated exact64 parent log-histogram coordinates; zero64 inputs (functional parent reference, not an active-capacity control). Compute all alternatives, parent path and gate in every cell, change only residual input. Three active modes have4256 added parameters; total predicted17191827, embedding17078688, dense113139. No second backbone or source checkpoint is loaded. Coarsened and histogram modes use only information already available to parent. Lower bound adds no information beyond count/mean/second; its isolated utility is not claimed. Novelty remains unverified; local composition and controlled incremental value are the proposed contribution.
predictions: Primary: compact_continuous full-population validation AUC exceeds frozen exchangeable_joint .6218776973444221 and oldest_bound .6205915285296155, and exceeds compact_zero, compact_coarsened and compact_duplicate_histogram under paired seeds. Source gaps and same-seed control gaps are reported separately.

If continuous-age access matters, full-vs-coarsened improvement persists across paired repetitions; improvement only over zero but equaled by redundant readouts supports access/optimization rather than new temporal information.

Synthetic histories with fixed identities/actions and ages45000,50000 versus55000,60000 share all parent bucket/tie/ordering features and both redundant readouts but differ in continuous mean/second/lower. Host diagnostics must confirm this representation separation before interpretation. A witness is an expressivity check, not a predictive experiment.

Zero residual is algebraically zero even after training, and initial added residual is zero for all modes. Parent parameters are initialized identically; copied efficient parent path must reproduce inherited parent logits. All modes share raw counts and feature construction; empty inputs/cells have zero evidence.

Report Logloss, allocated/dense/embedding counts, host wall and training/GPU seconds if provided, examples processed if provided, peak memory, throughput and batch p50/p95 latency for all variants versus both sources. Extra computation may make prediction quality improve without efficiency improvement.

Diagnostic review thresholds: count conservation, histogram copy, common-count, zero-input, empty/missing-cell and witness bucket errors should be zero up to1e-6; direct continuous/coarse means and seconds within1e-5; parent path within1e-5; lower-envelope direct and reversal errors are reported separately, with1e-3 as a provisional investigation trigger given inherited source cancellation. These are review thresholds, not certified float32 bounds or permission to hide smaller failures. Witness parent feature/logit error should be within1e-5 and continuous feature gap should be about .06893247; redundant witnesses should be zero. Learned witness residual gap may be zero and is not forced to meet a prediction.
falsifiers: Failure to exceed exchangeable_joint leaves incremental complementarity unsupported regardless of improvement over the weaker compact source.

A full gain reproduced by the equally allocated histogram or coarsened controls does not support continuous-age information as its explanation. A gain only in one adaptive seed is preliminary, not repeated support.

Parent reproduction, histogram identity, count conservation, witness bucket equality or missing/empty/padding invariance failures invalidate mechanism interpretation until resolved; record failed receipts and costs.
Nonfinite logits/gradients or exceeding the per-trial cap is an implementation/cost failure, distinct from a valid null result. No automatic retry for unknown execution state.
alternative_explanations: All evidence comes from seed42 frozen source receipts with adaptive validation reuse; seed variability, selection noise and calibration changes can mimic improvements. No test feedback is available.

Extra head capacity, nonlinear reparameterization, gated access to existing pools and optimization changes induced by new gradient paths may explain a gain. Active controls match allocated parameters and compute, not effective rank or learned functions. Zero mode is only a functional/reproduction reference.

Continuous-vs-coarsened contrasts change numerical basis and scale as well as information. Full advantage plus a witness supports this implementation, not a proof that an information gain causes all performance improvement.

Shared match groups already supply counts, histograms and learned age buckets. The parent may already approximate useful continuous freshness; both sources can be redundant. No source-synergy factorial is performed, and improvement is not attributed to interaction with any particular parent head.

Compact moments include all valid events, including missing-field events and tied times, whereas the parent transition branch excludes incomplete pairs and all tied complete timestamps. Full-vs-coarsened uses identical support, but comparison with transition-alone explanations retains this distinction.

Source oldest_bound reports float32 lower-bound violations up to .00031549 and input reversal logit gap .00008488; preserve its selected formula and measure roundoff, do not advertise certified bounds or exact numerical invariance. Clamp negative variance to zero; review errors against stated tolerances.

Only five successful receipts are supplied; searches for compact/exchangeable/count/oldest agent memory returned no hits. Ancestral failed/abandoned trajectories are not available as observed outcomes; no unseen success or failure is inferred from their names.

Constructor-prefix equality preserves parent tensor initialization, but appended allocations consume RNG after the parent. If the host uses the same global RNG for subsequent sampling, source-vs-zero exact training reproduction is not guaranteed. No RNG state or host sampling is modified. All four new cells have identical allocation/RNG paths, and compact_zero is the functional reference for the new comparison; inspect its host receipt against the frozen incumbent before relying on exact cross-generation numerical reproduction.
